mentions.title: How Mercedes got their front wing upgrade in the sweet spot
mentions.summary: Mark Hughes and Giorgio Piola divulge how Mercedes managed to get their front wing upgrade to work from Austin onwards.

mentions.title: McLaren to bring upgrades to Brazil GP with F1 2027 in mind
mentions.summary:
McLaren will introduce upgrades to its MCL40 Formula 1 car at this weekend’s Brazil Grand Prix, featuring a front wing concept which is expected to feature on its 2027 challenger.
The team had surged to the front when it substantially updated the MCL40 in Hungary, with Lando Norris winning that race and the following one at Zandvoort, but it has since slipped back in the pecking order despite ...Keep reading
